content: Standard pattern: FastAPI + Uvicorn ASGI server hosting ONNX Runtime session(s) for YOLOv8/YOLO11 inference, OpenCV for image decode/preprocess, exposed as an internal REST endpoint consumed by Node/Express. ONNX Runtime is recommended over raw PyTorch for CPU deployment (lower memory, better CPU-optimized kernels). Containerize as its own Docker service, independently scalable/restartable from the Node backend.
